key_impacts: Damaged public and private buildings required structural assessment.
Unsafe structures were demolished due to earthquake damage.
Large quantities of debris required clearance to enable reconstruction.
Emergency income support was provided to earthquake victims.
evidence_snippets: Demolition of private and government structures terminally damaged by the earthquake.
Overwhelming quantities of debris are left in the path of the earthquake.

key_impacts: A 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck the Pacific Coast of Ecuador.
Shelter operations required monitoring and evaluation following the quake.
UN Volunteers were deployed as frontline responders across multiple sectors.
evidence_snippets: 7.8-magnitude earthquake that hit the Pacific Coast of Ecuador on 16 April 2016.
Fifty national and international UN Volunteers were deployed as frontline responders.
Areas of intervention included: monitoring and evaluation of shelters.
